StegoRSA
Cryptography
Easy
by Yahaya Meddy
·
picoCTF 2026
A message has been encrypted using RSA. The public key is gone… but someone might have been careless with the private key. Can you recover it and decrypt the message? Download the flag
 and image
.

Solution:

                                                                                                                                                                                 
┌──(kali㉿kali)-[~/Desktop/picoCTF 2026/Cryptography/StegoRSA]
└─$ ls
flag.enc  image.jpg  solution.txt

# Now we can see that the comment section is containing a large hex data. Copy this hex text
# Go to https://gchq.github.io/CyberChef/
# Paste comment section hex code inside input section of CyberChef website
# Inside Output section click on magic wand icon and you will the get the private key. 
                                                                                      
create the private key file using nano and paste (Cntrl + Shift + v) your decoded private key inside.
┌──(kali㉿kali)-[~/Desktop/picoCTF 2026/Cryptography/StegoRSA]
└─$ nano private.pem
# exit the nano editor using (Cntrl + O, press Enter, Cntrl + X)

# Verify that the key is valid                                             
┌──(kali㉿kali)-[~/Desktop/picoCTF 2026/Cryptography/StegoRSA]
└─$ openssl pkey -in private.pem -check -noout
Key is valid
                                                                                                                                                                                 
┌──(kali㉿kali)-[~/Desktop/picoCTF 2026/Cryptography/StegoRSA]
└─$ file flag.enc
flag.enc: data
                                                                                                                                                                                 
┌──(kali㉿kali)-[~/Desktop/picoCTF 2026/Cryptography/StegoRSA]
└─$ ls -lh flag.enc
-rw------- 1 kali kali 256 Sep 27 02:17 flag.enc
  
# Finally use the private key to decrypt the encrypted flag inside flag.enc and store into the new file called flag.txt
┌──(kali㉿kali)-[~/Desktop/picoCTF 2026/Cryptography/StegoRSA]
└─$ openssl pkeyutl -decrypt -inkey private.pem -in flag.enc -out flag.txt
                                                                                                                                                                                 
┌──(kali㉿kali)-[~/Desktop/picoCTF 2026/Cryptography/StegoRSA]
└─$ ls             
flag.enc  flag.txt  image.jpg  private.pem  solution.txt
                                                                                                                                                                                 
┌──(kali㉿kali)-[~/Desktop/picoCTF 2026/Cryptography/StegoRSA]
└─$ cat flag.txt
